sections.label: Four criteria for withdrawal
sections.summary: The four criteria are terminal illness, permanent incapacitation, unsound mind and severely impaired life expectancy, and the Life Insurance Association framework is not appropriate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: The four criteria are: having a terminal illness, permanent incapacitation, suffering from an unsound mind, and having a severely impaired life expectancy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: It is not appropriate to adopt the Critical Illness Framework of the Life Insurance Association as the definition for severely impaired life expectancy, as suggested by the Member.

sections.label: CPF Board withdrawal approvals
sections.summary: The CPF Board approved about 1,000 applications each year, with terminally ill members withdrawing all savings and others withdrawing after setting aside a reduced Retirement Sum of $40,300.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: In the last two years, the CPF Board approved about 1,000 applications each year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: CPF members who are terminally ill will be able to withdraw all their retirement savings in one lump sum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Members who are permanently incapacitated, suffer from an unsound mind or have a severely impaired life expectancy will be able to make a lump-sum withdrawal from their retirement savings after setting aside a reduced Retirement Sum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Currently, it is $40,300, which is about half the current Basic Retirement Sum.

sections.label: Five thousand dollar cap
sections.summary: The Member asks whether to raise the $5,000 cap, but raising it would deprive more members of the concession.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: If I understand the Member's point correctly, he is asking whether we should raise the $5,000 cap.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: I would hesitate to do so because how the cap works is this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: A member, having set aside the reduced Retirement Sum and if the balance is less than $5,000, then they do not qualify under the scheme because the amount is too small.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: So, in other words, if we were to raise the sum, more and more of them will be deprived of this concession.
